title: Evaluation preserves the normalization equation of a specified presheaf map
statement: Let Y be a scheme and q:R→S a commutative ring map. Let C,K lie in D(Y_et,R) and C′,K′ in D(Y_et,S), with specified arrows dC:C→Res_q(C′), dK:K→Res_q(K′) [def-weil-pbc-derived-normalization-arrows]. Let p:P(C,K)→P(C′,K′) be a map of the actual local derived Isom presheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-local-isomorphism-sheaf]. Assume that for every etale U and actual local isomorphism e, e.hom followed by the localized dK equals the localized dC followed by Res_q(p_U(e).hom), using the canonical etale coefficient mate [def-weil-pbc-etale-isomorphism-normalization-arrow]. For every affine weakly contractible pro-etale U, evaluation [def-weil-pbc-source-derived-isomorphism-evaluation] of the sheafification of p satisfies the same square with the canonical localProEtaleNormalization arrows. This statement preserves an already specified map; it asserts no existence or universality of normalization, and no finiteness, lisse, boundedness or nonempty-stalk hypothesis.

source.place: Tags 09BV and 0F63, functoriality of sheafification and its inverse unit on weakly contractible affines; Tags 03DA and 098K, coefficient mate pasting.

proof.text: Construct coefficient restriction on slice Hom presheaves. Transport the given presheaf map p to the slice Isom presheaves. The canonical etale coefficient mate pastes with slice-to-source localization. Full faithfulness of the localization equivalence therefore turns hp into the corresponding slice normalization equation.

Express that equation as equality of the two presheaf maps into Hom(C,Res K′): projection from Isom followed by postcomposition with dK, and p followed by projection, coefficient restriction, and precomposition with dC. Apply sheafification and comparison pullback. Evaluation is natural in the two derived objects and sends the Isom-to-Hom projection to the underlying morphism; these identities follow directly by transposing the local comparison identities and cancelling the bijective pro-etale sheafification units. Coefficient-restriction evaluation is the separately proved Hom restriction lemma. These formulas give the slice normalization square.

Paste the canonical pro-etale coefficient mate with slice-to-source localization, and identify the comparison/coefficient mate with comparisonRestrictScalarsIso. Conjugate the slice square by the four localization isomorphisms. Naturality and cancellation give exactly the displayed localProEtaleNormalization square. Naturality of sheafification identifies the transported p-section with the section in the original statement.

theorem sourceIsomorphism_normalized_presheaf_evaluation
    (Y : Scheme.{t}) {R S : Type (t + 1)} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (q : R →+* S)
    (C K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{t + 1} R)))
    (C' K' : DerivedCategory (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{t + 1} S)))
    (dC : C ⟶ (normalizationRestrict Y.smallEtaleTopology q).obj C')
    (dK : K ⟶ (normalizationRestrict Y.smallEtaleTopology q).obj K')
    (p : derivedLocalIsomorphismPresheaf C K ⟶ derivedLocalIsomorphismPresheaf C' K')
    (hp : ∀ (U : Y.Etale) (e : (localIsomorphismRestriction Y R U).obj C ≅
        (localIsomorphismRestriction Y R U).obj K),
      e.hom ≫ etaleIsomorphismNormalizationArrow Y q dK U =
        etaleIsomorphismNormalizationArrow Y q dC U ≫
          (normalizationRestrict U.left.smallEtaleTopology q).map
            (p.app (op U) e).hom)
    (U : Y.ProEt) (ha : IsAffine U.left)
    (hw : (ProEt.topology Y).IsWeaklyContractible.{t + 1} U)
    (s : ((comparisonSetUpperStar Y).obj
      (derivedLocalIsomorphismSheaf C K)).obj.obj (op U)) :
    (sourceDerivedIsoEvaluation Y R C K U ha hw s).hom ≫
        localProEtaleNormalization U.hom q dK =
      localProEtaleNormalization U.hom q dC ≫
        (normalizationRestrict (ProEt.topology U.left) q).map
          (sourceDerivedIsoEvaluation Y S C' K' U ha hw
            (((comparisonSetUpperStar Y).map
              ((presheafToSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (Type (t + 1))).map p)).hom.app
                (op U) s)).hom
